newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks end at unofficial record on data.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks end at unofficial record on data.

text.p: Mexican stocks ended at yet another unofficial record on Thursday after midday bargain-hunters stayed in the market to push prices back into positive territory.
Dealers said the market had sagged on intraday profit-taking in early trade, but found a second wind on strong trade data released late morning.
Preliminary figures placed the leading IPC share index was up 24.55 points when the closing bell rang, or 0.51 percent, at 4,861.04. Final data were expected shortly.
